title: UN political declaration on pandemic prevention, preparedness and response

charter.in: The UN General Assembly's political declaration on pandemic prevention, preparedness and response, a nonbinding UN instrument separate from the WHO Pandemic Agreement: the disputes over its text around the September 2026 high-level meeting, the US objection to it, and its adoption.
out: The WHO Pandemic Agreement's PABS annex negotiations
The WHO Pandemic Agreement itself and its adoption
WHO preparedness and surveillance initiatives (24-hour detection target, Pandemic Fund, BioHub)
Outbreaks themselves and general warnings about outbreak risk
charter.endEvent: The General Assembly adopts the declaration.

entries.title: US blocks UN pledge on future outbreak response
entries.why: The US blocks the UN political declaration on outbreak response, in disputes over sharing benefits and fair vaccine access: a setback for the declaration.

entries.title: UN members renew pledges to stop future outbreaks
entries.why: The General Assembly adopts its declaration, which the story calls separate from the WHO Pandemic Agreement: the development's end event.
